description: This file defines a custom ViewPager class (CustomViewPager) that allows enabling or disabling swipe gesture-based paging via a toggle method.

classes.name: CustomViewPager
classes.description: A subclass of ViewPager that allows enabling or disabling user swipe gestures for changing pages.

methods.name: CustomViewPager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the CustomViewPager with context and attribute set, defaulting to enabled.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Overrides to control whether touch events are handled based on the enabled flag.

methods.name: onInterceptTouchEvent
methods.description: Overrides to control whether touch event interception occurs based on the enabled flag.

methods.name: setPagingEnabled
methods.description: Method to enable or disable swipe gestures programmatically.
